title: Microscopy & Microanalysis 2025: Images From the Meeting
content: Thank you to everyone who attended Microscopy & Microanalysis 2025! We hope you experienced all aspects of the meeting: attending scientific sessions, renewing friendships, making new contacts, exploring the Exhibit Hall to see products from our Sustaining Members, visiting the MSA MegaBooth, the MAS and CIASEM booths, and perhaps seeing some attractions in Salt Lake City, our host city. Please enjoy a sampling of images captured during M&M 2025.
